name: ROY engine v1 (share-fit score + outcome-calibrated win conversion)
fit_target: vote-point shares (118 ballot-obs, 17 races) per Sean's original frame; winner-only used ONLY for win-conversion calibration

score.note: HR/RBI point-positive but CIs span zero; ship WAR-only, carry HR at 0 pending more seasons; AVG/SB dead

ros.rule: final WAR = banked + ROS projection; ROS -> 0 if idle > 8 days (roster/IL-aware)

win_conversion.form: P(leader beats field) via probit on score gaps
win_conversion.provenance: MLE on 17 race outcomes; reproduces 82% WAR-leader hit rate

regime_guard.rule: if model/market ratio >= 3x OR large counting-gap regime (field HR leader beats WAR leader by >= ~12 HR), suppress model display and anchor to market
regime_guard.provenance: WAR leader 2/5 in large-HR-gap races; Sept market Brier-optimal (T4, 45 markets)

current_output.NL_ROY: engine 63.8 Wetherholt vs market 3.5 -> REGIME GUARD FIRES -> display market-anchored
